entities.text: High Court Of Orissa At Cuttack
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party
 Mr. Debasish Biswal, A.S.C.
 Coram:
 Justice Chittaranjan Dash
 Order
1. Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and the State.

2. This is an application for bail U/s.438 Cr.P.C. filed by the Petitioner in apprehension of arrest for his alleged involvement in the offences U/s. 420, I.P.C. in connection with Cuttack Sadar P.S. Case No.723 of 2021 corresponding to G.R. Case No.3213 of 2021 pending in the court of the learned J.M.F.C. (Rural), Cuttack.
3. Allegedly the F.I.R. reveals the informant to have deposited some money in the Sahara India Parivar (Real Estate & Housing Scheme) with a hope to get good return after its maturity period.

entities.text: Sahara India Parivar (Real Estate & Housing Scheme)
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Money was deposited by the Informant through the present Petitioner being the authorized agent of Sahara India Parivar and Bond has been issued in favour of the Informant as against such deposits.
There is, however, no refund of money to the Informant despite the period of maturity having lapsed since 2018.
This being the situation, the present Petitioner has hardly any scope to refund the money as against the Bond issued to the Informant.

Be that as it may, on the allurement of the Petitioner being the Agent since the informant deposited money expecting a good return at the time of his need having not complied, the present Petitioner cannot shift his responsibility towards the company.

In that view of the matter, considering the nature of the allegations as emerged from the materials on Kailash Chandra Patra vs State Of Odisha .... Opposite Party on 23 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/138061608/
1 record, the circumstances appearing and the seriousness and gravity of the offence, while this Court is not inclined to grant anticipatory bail, it is directed that the Petitioner if so chooses may surrender before the learned J.M.F.C., (Rural), Cuttack in the aforesaid G.R. Case No.3213 of 2021 during the first hour within three weeks from today and move for bail.

entities.text: Kailash Chandra Patra vs State Of Odisha .... Opposite Party
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In such event, the learned Magistrate shall consider the bail application of the Petitioner in the first hour of the day itself, strictly on the basis of the materials available on record.
In case of rejection of the bail application by the learned Magistrate, the Petitioner may move for bail before the higher forum in the second hour of the same day.

In that event, the higher forum shall consider and dispose of the bail application of the Petitioner on the same day on merit, strictly on the basis of the materials available on record without being influenced by any observation made herein by this Court or presuming it to be a direction in affirmative.
5. The Case Diary be made available to the learned courts below as far as possible to facilitate disposal of the bail application of the Petitioner on the same day itself.
However, the learned courts shall apply their own wisdom in dealing with the application for bail.
The ABLAPL is disposed of accordingly.
(Chittaranjan Dash) Judge S.K.Parida Kailash Chandra Patra vs State Of Odisha ....
